[[Arena at Gwinnett Center]] |champion= |bowl= |bowl_result= }} {{2011–12 ACC men's basketball standings}} The '''2011–12 Georgia Tech Yellow Jackets men's basketball team''' represented the [[Georgia Institute of Technology]] during the [[2011–12 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Yellow Jackets, led by first-year head coach [[Brian Gregory]], are members of the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]]. Due to renovations at their regular home arena, the [[Alexander Memorial Coliseum]], the Yellow Jackets played their home games at [[Philips Arena]] and the [[Arena at Gwinnett Center]]. They finished the season 11–20, 4–12 in ACC play to finish in a tie for last place. They lost in the first round of the [[2012 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC Basketball tournament]] to Miami.{{cite news|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/320682390 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240301222212/https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/320682390 |url-status=dead |archive-date=March 1, 2024 |title=Miami uses 18-0 run to end Georgia Tech's year|work=[[ESPN]]|date=March 8, 2012|access-date=March 1, 2024}} ==Roster== {| class="wikitable" style="font-size: 95%;" !
